description: Predefined overlap Q ranges for known EQSANS configuration pairs. Used by /stitch smart. Configs listed in low-Q -> high-Q order.

overlaps.note: 30Hz frame-skipping: frame_0 (low-Q, ~4m 9.5A) and frame_1 (high-Q, ~4m 2.5A). Matches any config containing 'frame0'/'frame1' or 'frame_0'/'frame_1'.
